title: AQ-06 to AQ-06R Finding-by-Finding Comparison
methodology: Every finding in reports/adsense-readiness-certification.json's risk_register (the AQ-06 final risk register) is carried forward and assigned exactly one status, with fresh evidence gathered for this comparison — not assumed from AQ-07's own self-reported PASS. No finding is silently dropped.

findings.aq06_title: Templated/jargon-leaking prose across 4 domains (328 leaf + 56 group + 10 category entities)
findings.evidence: Directly targeted and remediated by AQ-07A-H. AQ-07's own final certification reports 0 rendered governance-language hits (was 999), 0 critical/high/medium/low grammar findings, 0 collapsed wine narratives (was 75/75 legume entities identical). Independently re-verified in AQ-06R2 (see reports/adsense-editorial-rerun-06r.json) by re-running AQ-07B's scanner fresh and by direct reading of the live regenerated HTML, not by trusting AQ-07's self-report alone.
findings.scope_note: AQ-07's remediation additionally covered protein's 17 groups + 3 categories and cheese's 9 groups, which were not part of AQ-06's original 328/56/10 count — AQ-06's finding is fully subsumed, not partially closed.

findings.aq06_title: Named-author claim exists only in JSON-LD, invisible to human readers
findings.evidence: Re-checked directly: the homepage's visible rendered text still does not contain 'Gustavo' or any authored-by phrase — the claim remains present only inside the FAQPage JSON-LD block. AQ-07's scope was catalog narrative fields (summary/seo_description/introduction/beginner_notes); it never touched index.html's static content, correctly, since that was never part of its mandate.

findings.aq06_title: No cookie-consent mechanism for future personalized-ads compliance
findings.evidence: Re-checked directly: no cookie-banner/cookie-consent/consent-banner implementation found in index.html or assets/js/*.js. Unaffected by AQ-07, which did not touch site-wide technical infrastructure.

findings.aq06_title: 4 dead 'View Bottle' links on Template A dish pages
findings.evidence: Re-checked directly: 5 dish/pairing HTML files still contain 'View Bottle' (href="#") dead links. Outside AQ-07's scope (dish-pairing pages are a separate template system from the food-ontology catalog).
Re-checked directly: 5 dish/pairing HTML files still show unexplained 'Pairing Strength' percentages with no visible methodology note. Outside AQ-07's scope.

Re-checked directly: the repeated sentence structure '{Wine} is the best if the dish is smoky for {dish} because {reason}' is confirmed still present verbatim across wine-with-grilled-steak.html, wine-for-bbq-ribs.html, and wine-with-smoked-pork.html. The wine-education tier runs on an entirely separate content system from the food-ontology catalog (established out of scope since AQ-02B) and was never part of AQ-07's mandate.
Re-checked directly: disclaimer.html contains no allergen/food-safety-specific language. Unaffected by AQ-07.

findings.aq06_title: Legal pages read as generic multi-product boilerplate rather than site-specific
findings.evidence: AQ-06 itself classified this as 'legitimate, common practice for a small operator — not a defect,' not a finding requiring closure. Re-confirmed unchanged (privacy.html still reads 'operated by Albor Digital LLC' generically) — carried forward as the same non-defect observation, not reclassified as a new problem.

findings.aq06_title: Mobile usability and Core Web Vitals not independently measured
findings.evidence: A disclosed scope limitation in AQ-06, not a defect — AQ-06R's own mandate (per its ticket) does not require a performance audit either. Carried forward as the same explicitly-out-of-scope item, not silently dropped.

summary: AQ-06's single high-severity finding (AQ06-HC-01) is CLOSED, fully subsumed by AQ-07's remediation, which covered more ground than the original finding. The 6 STILL OPEN findings (2 medium, 4 low) were never in AQ-07's scope and were not expected to change — none regressed, none are new. 2 informational items are carried forward as non-defects, not reclassified. No AQ-06 finding was silently dropped.
